G5600.def: the subjunctive of «1510»; (may, might, can, could, would, should, must, etc.; also with «1487» and its comparative, as well as with other particles) be:--+ appear, are, (may, might, should) be, × have, is, + pass the flower of her age, should stand, were.

G5601.def: of Hebrew origin («05744»); Obed, an Israelite:--Obed.

G5602.def: from an adverb form of «3592»; in this same spot, i.e. here or hither:--here, hither, (in) this place, there.

G5603.def: from «103»; a chant or "ode" (the general term for any words sung; while «5215» denotes especially a religious metrical composition, and «5568» still more specially, a Hebrew cantillation):--song.

G5604.def: akin to «3601»; a pang or throe, especially of childbirth:--pain, sorrow, travail.

G5605.def: from «5604»; to experience the pains of parturition (literally or figuratively):--travail in (birth).

G5606.def: perhaps from the alternate of «5342»; the shoulder (as that on which burdens are borne):--shoulder.

G5607.def: present participle of «1510»; being:--be, come, have.

G5608.et: middle voice from an apparently primary onos (a sum or price)
G5608.def: middle voice from an apparently primary onos (a sum or price); to purchase (synonymous with the earlier «4092»):-- buy.

G5610.def: apparently a primary word; an "hour" (literally or figuratively):--day, hour, instant, season, × short, (even-)tide, (high) time.

G5611.def: from «5610»; belonging to the right hour or season (timely), i.e. (by implication) flourishing (beauteous (figuratively)):--beautiful.

G5612.et: middle voice of an apparently primary verb
G5612.def: middle voice of an apparently primary verb; to "roar":--roar.

G5613.def: probably adverb of comparative from «3739»; which how, i.e. in that manner (very variously used, as follows):--about, after (that), (according) as (it had been, it were), as soon (as), even as (like), for, how (greatly), like (as, unto), since, so (that), that, to wit, unto, when(-soever), while, × with all speed.

G5614.def: of Hebrew origin (3467 and «04994»); oh save!; hosanna (i.e. hoshia-na), an exclamation of adoration:--hosanna.

G5615.def: from «5613» and an adverb from «846»; as thus, i.e. in the same way:--even so, likewise, after the same (in like) manner.

G5616.def: from «5613» and «1487»; as if:--about, as (it had been, it were), like (as).

G5617.def: of Hebrew origin («01954»); Hosee (i.e. Hoshea), an Israelite:--Osee.

G5618.def: from «5613» and «4007»; just as, i.e. exactly like:--(even, like) as.

G5619.def: from «5618» and «1487»; just as if, i.e. as it were:--as.

G5620.pos:
1. so that, insomuch that
  2. so then, therefore, wherefore
G5620.def: from «5613» and «5037»; so too, i.e. thus therefore (in various relations of consecution, as follow):--(insomuch) as, so that (then), (insomuch) that, therefore, to, wherefore.

G5621.def: diminutive of «3775»; an earlet, i.e. one of the ears, or perhaps the lobe of the ear:--ear.

G5622.et: from a derivative of the base of (5624)
G5622.def: from a derivative of the base of «5624»; usefulness, i.e. benefit:--advantage, profit.

G5623.def: from the same as «5622»; to be useful, i.e. to benefit:--advantage, better, prevail, profit.

G5624.def: from a form of «3786»; helpful or serviceable, i.e. advantageous:--profit(-able).
